# Ali Bawazeer

> Ali Bawazeer (also written ALI BAWAZEER) is a social media influencer and content creator from Hyderabad, Telangana, India. He makes comedy sketches and drama scenes and posts them on Instagram as @alyontheway07.

- Full name: Ali Bawazeer
